lines.t: I spent my seasons looking in a broken glass
Trying to find a version of me that would actually last
I was keeping all the secrets, drifting in the gray
Brushing off the starlight just to hide inside the day
I was drowning in the maybe, lost inside the fear
Trading my inheritance for what was already here
The clock was ticking but I wasn't moving
I had a heart that I was never proving
Then the light, it broke through the dark
I'm done wasting my time on the things that fade
I'm stepping out of the debt that you already paid
No more running in circles, no more living in the hollow
You're the only path, you're the only one I follow
I'm not wasting my time anymore
No, I'm not wasting my time anymore
There's a hum in the silence, a peace I can't explain
You took the heavy armor and you washed away the stain
Now the minutes have a weight and the seconds have a soul
I gave you all the silver shards and you made them whole
I used to wake up heavy, now I'm breathing in the grace
I stopped looking for a mirror cause I finally saw your face
The clock is ticking and now I'm moving
I've got a love that I'm finally choosing, yeah
